headline: MBARI Senior Scientist Kelly Benoit-Bird named a California Academy of Sciences Fellow
summary: The California Academy of Sciences has named MBARI Senior Scientist Kelly Benoit-Bird a 2026 Fellow, recognizing her contributions to the field of marine ecology to advance the Academy’s mission to regenerate the natural world through science, learning, and collaboration.
imageAlt: A scientist holding a framed award certificate poses for a photo inside a science museum.
